stem.text: Three samples of chlorine gas each contain 0.710 g of chlorine. Each sample is reacted with a reagent.

items: In the first reaction a sample is reacted completely with hydrogen gas.
In the second reaction a sample is reacted completely with cold $\text{NaOH(aq)}$.
In the third reaction a sample is reacted completely with hot $\text{NaOH(aq)}$.

stem.text: Which masses of the named products would be formed?

items: Exactly 0.730 g of $\text{HCl}$ form in the first reaction.
Exactly 0.585 g of $\text{NaCl}$ form in the second reaction.
Exactly 0.975 g of $\text{NaCl}$ form in the third reaction.
